name: Hongfa Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Hongfa Technology Co., Ltd. manufactures and supplies relays, medium and low voltage electrical appliances, high and low voltage complete equipment, connectors, capacitors, precision parts, and automation equipment worldwide. The company offers power, automotive, high voltage dc, latching, signal, high-frequency, reed, industrial, and solid-state relays; relay socket and module; application electronic modules; low-voltage devices, such as control appliance, distribution appliance, and terminal apparatus; and fuse, vacuum interrupters, and automation equipment.
